cd /workspace && cat > dev/test_e2e_replay.py <<'PYEOF'
import json, random, sys, subprocess, time
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/dev')
import ref_replay
rng=random.Random(int(time.time())%100000)
lines=[];exps=[]
for i in range(150):
    nnodes=rng.randint(2,9)
    nodes=['n%d'%j for j in range(nnodes)]
    caps=dict((n,rng.choice([0,1,2,rng.randint(0,512)])) for n in nodes)
    nf=rng.randint(1,12)
    flows=[]
    for j in range(nf):
        k=rng.randint(2,nnodes)
        path=rng.sample(nodes,k)
        H=rng.choice([8,9,20,rng.randint(8,256)])
        nd=rng.randint(0,H-5)
        kinds=['D']*nd+['Q','T']+['K']*(H-2-nd)+['Z']*0
        rng.shuffle(kinds)
        tmpl=bytes(rng.randint(0,255) for _ in range(H))
        labels=[rng.choice([16,17,1048575,rng.randint(16,1048575)]) for _ in path]
        flows.append(dict(id='f%02d'%j,path=path,template=tmpl.hex(),kinds=''.join(kinds),labels=labels))
    events=[]
    for e in range(rng.randint(1,80)):
        r=rng.random(); f=rng.choice(flows)
        if r<0.34: events.append(dict(op='put',flow=f['id'],node=rng.choice(f['path'])))
        elif r<0.50: events.append(dict(op='enable',flow=f['id']))
        elif r<0.60: events.append(dict(op='disable',flow=f['id']))
        elif r<0.63: events.append(dict(op='reset'))
        else:
            H=len(f['template'])//2; kinds=f['kinds']; tmpl=bytes.fromhex(f['template'])
            hdr=bytearray(tmpl)
            for x,c in enumerate(kinds):
                if c!='K': hdr[x]=rng.randint(0,255)
            if rng.random()<0.1: hdr[rng.randrange(H)]^=0xff
            hdr[kinds.index('Q')]=rng.choice([0,7,8,255])
            hdr[kinds.index('T')]=rng.choice([0,1,2,rng.randint(0,255)])
            pl=rng.randint(0,600)
            events.append(dict(op='packet',flow=f['id'],header=bytes(hdr).hex(),payload=bytes(rng.randint(0,255) for _ in range(pl)).hex()))
    req=dict(mode='replay',capacities=caps,flows=flows,events=events)
    lines.append(json.dumps(req)); exps.append(ref_replay.run(req))
data=''.join(l+'\n' for l in lines)
st=time.time()
r=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B','/workspace/submission/main.py'],input=data,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=200)
el=time.time()-st
outs=r.stdout.splitlines()
print('lines',len(lines),'outs',len(outs),'elapsed %.2f'%el,'stderr',r.stderr[:200])
bad=0
for i,(g,e) in enumerate(zip(outs,exps)):
    if json.loads(g)!=e:
        bad+=1
        if bad<2: print('DIFF at',i); print(g[:400]); print(json.dumps(e)[:400])
print('bad',bad)
PYEOF
